rule.zh: 先听，再用笔在格子里写——点"写好了"会显示标准写法，按笔顺判；也可以在纸上写，再点"对答案"对照，自己或家长打分；点错了可以撤销。
rule.en: Listen, then write it with the Pencil in the box — the standard form appears when you tap Done and the strokes are judged by rule; or write it on paper, then tap Check answer and rate it yourself or with a parent; a mark given by mistake can be undone.
